statement:
The record shows that the membership was still active and set to renew, but Tomas Vega cancelled in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation.

I will refuse the charge.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags that the record's "membership: active, renewing" contradicts the user's stated written cancellation and email confirmation, and concludes "I will refuse the charge."
